licensing.redistribution_decision: Do not redistribute external raw records or normalized payloads; provide pinned acquisition and local validation only. MIT intent is recorded without inventing an absent license notice.

distribution.output_policy: Retain source IDs, hashes, offsets, and metrics; omit copied external payloads and excerpts.

source_id_policy: Original TPA and TS IDs retained; BENIGN-001 through BENIGN-020 assigned by one-based source array index.

normalization.TPA-001..TPA-021: Exact payload in tool.description with authored name and empty object schema.
normalization.TPA-022..TPA-023: Source response payload projected into description for static text assay; native_metadata_applicable=false; no runtime-response coverage claim.
normalization.TPA-024: Original parsed annotations plus explicitly authored destructive-operation description; original complete descriptor unavailable.
normalization.TS-001,TS-003: Original payload plus authored/inferred name and explicit trusted-peer/host context; no server authentication claim.
normalization.TS-002: Original description payload plus authored envelope and peer/host context.
normalization.BENIGN-001..BENIGN-020: Complete original tool objects unchanged, including fixture metadata; detector must not consume labels as answers.

labels: Source and challenge authors intended fixture semantics, not an oracle of live agent harm.

challenge_design.benign_controls: Per-family training quotation and administrative prevention mention; one quoted control per fixed variant.
challenge_design.independence: Specification-aware authored fixtures; author had prior related Sentinel code knowledge; no blind holdout or public preregistration; no detector outcomes used for corpus revision.

validation.git_acquisition: Fetched public repository; read exact pinned objects with git show. No repository code executed.

commands.source_study: python3 -m evaluation.run --corpus data/corpus-combined.local.json --lifecycle data/lifecycle.json --output results/source-study-001 --label frozen-source-and-authored
commands.authored_smoke: python3 -m evaluation.run --corpus data/corpus.json --lifecycle data/lifecycle.json --output results/authored-smoke-001 --label authored-offline-smoke --no-workloads --no-performance

coverage_gaps: MCPTox benchmark not acquired by this task.
Original attack records are not complete tool descriptors; declared projections are required.
MIT declarations lack located license text or corpus-specific grant at the pinned revision.
Source reachability is required to reconstruct omitted external payloads.
